triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return false; if (!ctx.piece || ctx.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return false; return !!(piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'divine-shield'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return { success: false }; var tag = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'divine-shield'; }); if (!tag) { self.expire(); return { success: false }; } removeStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, tag.id); self.expire(); return { success: true, blocked: true, message: piece.name + '的圣盾抵挡了这次伤害！' }; }
